messages:
maya: heads-up — planning a staggered rollforward for engine/kernel + quant builds tonight during the quiet window (00:30-02:30 UTC). aiming for minimal blast radius, will do region-by-region slices.
liam: ping ops: are we ok to extend pin TTLs for a 6h window if needed?
sanjay: +1 on staggered. I want the canary slice to be smaller than usual (5% traffic) — last time we saw a perf noise at ~10%.
jess: can we gate on p95 latency and redis miss rate? suggest thresholds: p95 +100ms vs baseline OR redis misses > 2x for 5m -> abort.
ryan: noted. i'll wire alerts. which metrics dashboard should we reference in release notes?
maya: use runtime/engine/quant-canary dashboard (dash id: qk-ops-09). i'll add links in the release note draft.
liam: deploy-bot — please prepare pin command ready but don't execute until i ack. sample command i'll use: 
```
/deploybot pin engine:quant-v5.2 --ttl 6h --reason "staggered rollforward canary"
```
deploy-bot: acknowledged — pin command staged. will wait for explicit /deploybot run from @liam. reaction: :white_check_mark:
maya: ops, QA — we need a quick smoke checklist: 1) canary p95, 2) kv cache hit-rate, 3) per-model token throughput, 4) model outputs sanity (prompt set). anyone want to add?
sanjay: add GPU memory churn metric (per-host) — last hotflip showed an OOM spike on one host.
jess: add error-rates for quant fallback path too. if fallback increases >1% abort.
ryan: will create a short runbook in the thread with links to dashboard and alert rules. publishing in 5m.
maya: release notes: short blurb + link to changelog + safety paragraph about fallback to float kernel. draft below: 
"Runtime: rollforward kernel v9 + quant v5.2. Improves throughput for short-chat workloads. Canary staged by region; automatic fallback to float path if degradation detected. See dashboards and rollback criteria in runbook."
liam: looks good. one ask — add contact list (oncall, eng-runtime lead, release owner).
maya: added contacts: @liam (release owner), @sanjay (runtime lead), @jess (ops), @ryan (monitoring).
liam: ok i'm going to kick off the canary at 00:35 UTC unless someone objects in next 15m.
sanjay: obj: none. i'll be watching thermal and mem churn.
jess: i'm on standby for rollback. have rollback playbook ready: 
```
1) /deploybot unpin engine:quant-v5.2  # immediate stop new rollouts
2) rollback config to engine:v8 bundle via deploybot
3) verify p95 and kv metrics return to baseline
4) document incident, notify stakeholders
```
ryan: alert rules uploaded: runtime-canary-p95, runtime-kv-miss-spike, quant-fallback-rate. they map to PagerDuty runbook "engine-rollforward".
deploy-bot: canary slice applied to region eu-west-1 at 00:36 UTC, variant engine:quant-v5.2, slice 5%.
maya: canary live. please confirm smoke: p95 looks +12ms so far, kv hit stable.
jess: seeing a small bump in fallback but <0.2% — tolerable. continuing to watch.
sanjay: GPU mem churn on host eu-w1-node-12 spiked to 78% -> baseline 65%. watching for >85%.
liam: if GPU mem hits >85% on any host for 2 consecutive samples (1m resolution) we abort and unpin.
ryan: added that rule to the alert mapping.
maya: 00:50 update: canary progressing, no abort conditions hit. rolling next slice (eu-west-1 -> us-east-1) in 10m.
liam: quick note on release notes: add troubleshooting tip for customers using pinned older engine versions who see increased latency — explain fallback behavior and recommend updating to quant v5.2 when safe.
jess: good call. i'll add to notes.
liam: executing pin now to give us a safety leash: 
```
/deploybot pin engine:quant-v5.2 --ttl 6h --reason "rollforward safety leash"
```
deploy-bot: pin applied by @liam at 00:58 UTC. TTL expires in 6h.
maya: thanks. continuing roll slices. i'll post final status and a short postmortem if anything goes wrong.
sanjay: FYI i'm keeping a mem dump hook ready to capture if OOM near threshold.
jess: if we abort, i'll run the rollback steps and tag the incident with "engine-rollforward-abort".
ryan: final: dashboards and runbook links — https://grafana.internal/qk-ops-09 and https://wiki.internal/runbooks/engine-rollforward.
maya: closing updates: at 02:22 UTC rollforward completed for all regions. small transient fallback spikes in ap-southeast but reverted automatically. no rollback required. i'll file a short release note and attach perf diffs. :tada:
